mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy supports valuation multiples.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in unemployment rate below 6.0% signals labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances with UNRATE < 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand, supporting corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint growth in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, industrial production decline below 95.0 indicates supply constraints, triggering inflationary pressures and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, INDPRO < 95.0 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% annually signals rising inflation, prompting Fed rate hikes that compress equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Positive RSAFS growth over 6 months indicates sustained consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth over 6 months fails to predict positive 60-day returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline signal labor market tightness, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to predict positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 95.0 over 3 months indicates weakening supply capacity, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances with INDPRO < 95.0.
